name: EchoNet
description: This outline as a node on a FidoNet-style network of outlines: named views and tagged notes as areas, subscriptions by node mask that copy them in (copies that drift, never a sync), netmail both ways on marks, seen-by marks, a nodelist and a toss log. Nodes mail: each publishes a bulletin and hands packets to the others, and each outline's own tosser writes only its own notes.

offline.description: Nodes (name@machine) to treat as unreachable this toss: a lid shut on purpose

keepLogs.description: How many toss logs stay under the nodelist (default 20)

cap.description: New messages copied per source each toss when a subscription has no [cap::n] (default 25)

undeliverableAfter.description: Tosses netmail waits for an original that is gone before it becomes an undeliverable note (default 3)

actions.label: Toss mail
actions.description: Copies new messages from every subscribed area, marks copies whose original is newer or gone, carries netmail both ways, writes the nodelist and a toss log

actions.label: Write the nodelist
actions.description: Writes the nodelist again without tossing: each known node, reachable or not, its access, areas and subscriptions

actions.label: Take the newer version
actions.description: On an EchoNet copy: replaces its text with the original's current one (its own edits go; its history keeps them)

actions.label: Compare with the newer version
actions.description: On an EchoNet copy: proposes the original's current text beside it, the difference shown, to apply or dismiss

components.title: EchoNet subscriptions
components.intro: A note that reads an area from other outlines: `[subscribe::<node mask>]` names the nodes, `[echo::<area>]` the area. Each toss copies the new messages in under one source board per node (copies that drift, never a sync). The tosser writes the source boards, `[waiting::]` and the copies' own properties itself.

props.meaning: the nodes it reads: outline@machine, a mask (*@float-2, rexall-*@laptop, *@*), a bare name for any machine, or @<page> for a list; comma-separated
the area it reads, by name or mask (* matches across dots), comma-separated; case doesn't matter
what counts as new: all, or a date; left out, the first toss writes now
new copies a toss takes from each node, oldest first

components.title: EchoNet areas
components.intro: A named view other outlines can subscribe to: `[echo::<name>]` on a view (a note with a `[query::…]`, a board lane included). Its messages are its children, the notes tagged `[echo::<name>]`, and what its query matches. Subscribers bind to the name, so changing the query moves every subscriber with it. On a note without a query, `[echo::]` is a posting, not an area.

props.meaning: the area's name, dotted for a namespace that grows without coordination (ep0ch.requests); subscribers bind to it
